## Drawing and BOM review

- Open page-level drawing issues even when no precise location is available;
  zoom and pan to inspect the page. Issues with coordinates are highlighted.
- Review printed BOM rows on the drawing alongside their material-class match
  explanations and scope excerpts. A material match does not establish that an
  item is in scope. Rescan older jobs to collect drawing locations.
- Review drawing issues before a BOM is generated when a scan needs clarification.

## Scope and exports

- P&ID-derived scope drafts include available quantities and supply and
  installation responsibilities, and associate work notes with items only when
  the drawing explicitly links them. Unconfirmed work remains subject to review.
- Successful job BOM exports replace older generated BOM files for that job.
  Existing exports are retained if generation fails or requires review.

## AI settings

- The OpenAI provider is now listed as **ChatGPT (OpenAI API)**. Existing OpenAI
  settings are preserved. An OpenAI API key and API billing are required;
  a ChatGPT subscription does not provide API access.

Standard Windows and macOS downloads do not bundle Tesseract OCR.
